verdict.rationale: The probe found no machine-readable API spec: every candidate OpenAPI/Swagger path at dlthub.com returned 404. The dlt-init-openapi evidence describes consuming third-party OpenAPI specs to generate pipelines, which is a different capability from publishing dlt's own API spec. The MCP server card and llms.txt belong to other stories and do not count as a downloadable API spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
